svg.title: BlendLib geometric construction
svg.desc: Dimensions and vertices derive from the same parameters as the SVG master. Teal construction guides are not part of the logo.
svg.text: Shared vertices. Equal counters. One family of diagonal edges.
Construction guides are excluded from the master.
Export scale; the vector geometry is unit based.
Reference: existing BlendLib white icon / normalized reconstruction, not a pixel-identical trace.
